text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Whew... That's the whole routine done,
right?
Your training plans have really
taught me a lot!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
That's all the running for today, yes, but
you
should get some protein in once you
get back to
the dor—oh, is that...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for watching! I really hope I can
see you
again—munch'n on some
scrumptious eats out in
the beautiful
countryside of Tomakomai!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Maybe the wave should be a
little smaller.
That'd be more in line with
my sweet and sincere
PR persona...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Tarumae. Are you perhaps
practicing for
something?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Ah! F-Flash?! And El too?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
So you've been preparing for a
Tomakomai PR
event, then. You know,
when I see how much
work you pour into
your PR efforts, I'm always
deeply
impressed by the love you have for your

hometown.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(If I learn more about the feelings she
puts into
her efforts, it'll bring us that
much closer. Just like
before...)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Tarumae. If you wouldn't mind, could
you teach
me more about Tomakomai?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I wanna hear more too! You gotta give
us deets
on the good eats and scenery!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
You... you really mean it?! It'd be my
pleasure! Oh
gosh, let's stop by my
room. I've got all sorts of
guidebooks
and samples!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! This Tarumae Garo place looks
straight
outta a fairytale!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't it just?! The way the moss
drapes over the
stone, glistening in the
light... oh, it's like velvet!
The ridge is
sooo pretty!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I love these photos of Lake Utonai! The
water's so
clear, and just look at all the
birds—especially all
those swans!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... It reminds me of when I was
little. We
used to visit a lake all the
time.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, back in Germany? You've got to
tell me
about it! I bet your perspective
would make a
wonderful reference for
my Tomakomai PR!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Well, when it got to be vacation season,
my
parents would close the shop and
we'd spend
some time at a lakeside
lodge.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I'd sit in a lounge chair by the shore and
read, and
then sometimes I'd go out in a
canoe and admire
the scenery and
birdwatch from the water.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
At night, everything would fall quiet,
and I'd
listen to owls hooting in the
distance as I looked
up at the stars. They
were always so bright and
clear out
there.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I completely get you. It definitely
sounds like
a relaxing place for a
vacation!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
You know what else screams vacation?
The
Mexican Caribbean! My dad's told
me all about
it—the fiery sun, the bright
blue waves!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Another thing we're working on is
Tomakomai
souvenirs, so I'm hoping to
develop some haskap
sweets with the
cooperation of local businesses.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I've got some of the haskap jam we'll be
using
here, so please, go ahead and take
some!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Oh, thank you. I'll have to try baking
with it. I'll
bring you some ideas.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Back home, our shop sells cakes starring
local
ingredients too, so I might be able
to whip up a
recipe that highlights the
haskap's flavor.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Really?! Flash, you're the best! If you
wouldn't
mind, that'd be absolutely
amazing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I'm strolling through campus one day,
I spot
Eishin Flash and friends sharing a
cake.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I'd say the appearance meets spec! Nice
and
balanced, and the jam's vibrant
color really pops.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
It looks perfect! It'd definitely be a huge
hit with
the Umasta crowd!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Tarumae gifted me some haskap
jam, so I
tried baking a tart with it.
choice_data_list: みんなでケーキを作ったのか？
みんなでケーキを作ったの？
choice_data_list_en: Did you all bake a cake together?
Did you make a cake together with everyone?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And now, it's taste test time! Here
goooes!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Mm, it came out nicely. The tartness of
the
haskap jam gives it a bright,
refreshing flavor.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Mmmm! It's so good! This'll be all over Umasta for sure! I'll get the recipe to the folks back home straightawa—ah?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Squaaaaak!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ah?! Mamb—I-I mean, what's with this
totally
random condor, landing on my
shoulder outta
nowhere? Ahaha... ha...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, seems like our feathered friend
here wants
a piece too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The trio cheerfully enjoy their little cake
party
with the hawk perched happily on
El Condor
Pasa's shoulder.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Hm, it's not bad. I think it needs about
three
percent more haskap to balance
the fla—ah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Squaaaaak!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Mambo?! I-I mean, uh, random condor!
This
cake's not for birds so don't you try

anythi—STOP! Stop, it's not for youuuu!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
E-El, wait! It's fine, there's plenty to go
around!
Come back!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The hawk circles above, trophy in talons,
happily
watching over the little cake
party.
